Reasoning: This release stage is encoded as a fixed end-effector pose plus gripper opening. freeze_position keeps the panda_fingertip frame origin fixed at its current world position, representing no intentional end-effector translation during opening. freeze_orientation keeps the immediately preceding grasp-and-lower orientation fixed without imposing any new tool-axis relation. open_gripper commands the gripper to the fully open/released state. The required cube_2 observation target relative to cube_1 is not emitted as a separate reach_point because the stage already needs freeze_position and the API permits at most one position operator; additionally, after release the API has no direct constraint for an arbitrary non-gripped observed object remaining at a target. Gripper finger effort/contact drop is also not directly representable by the available condition labels without misusing manipulator_low_effort, which is defined for arm/TCP interaction rather than finger squeeze.
